name: COMM 5050
title: Communication Pedagogy
description: Theoretical and applied aspects of teaching in the field of Communication. Emphasis on the development of pedagogical best practices suitable to a range of settings and specializations in the field. Topics may include: Instructional techniques, facilitating course discussion, online teaching and learning, active learning, alternative pedagogies, inclusive teaching, evaluation of student learning, curriculum design and management, academic program assessment, and communication across the academy.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Communication, others with consent.
